name: throughline
description: Start with /throughline:start. Gives your AI agent the context it is missing about your business: a local goal ladder, the action items still open and on whom, and a 10-check diagnosis of your repo. Runs on your machine — no account.

throughline_token.title: Throughline API token
throughline_token.description: Only for a repo connected to a hosted Throughline (invite-only). Leave empty to use the plugin fully locally.
